entries.name: HinkalHelper
entries.description: Unverified helper of the Hinkal contract. Its verified predecessor checks that the relayer is whitelisted and is tx.origin, checks calldata integrity and transaction dimensions, and builds the public inputs of the proof from the transaction data.

hinkalAddress.description: Hinkal contract that may call the helper. Its address is part of the public inputs of every proof.

relayers.description: Whitelisted relayers. A relayed transaction must be sent by one of them.

MAX_LEAVES_PD.description: Maximum number of commitments in one proofless deposit.

entries.name: HinkalWrapper
entries.description: Periphery contract for proofless deposits into Hinkal. It takes the deposit fee in ETH or a token, pulls the deposited tokens from the user and forwards them to the configured Hinkal contract.

hinkal.description: Hinkal contract that receives the deposits. The owner can change it.

entries.name: DepositOnChainUtxosExternalAction
entries.description: Hinkal external action that deposits tokens from the transaction's original sender as one or more notes, pulling them with that sender's approval. Scheduled sends deposit through it.

entries.name: Emporium
entries.description: Upgradeable Hinkal external action with an unverified implementation. Its verified predecessor runs a batch of arbitrary calls with shielded funds, optionally through a user's HinkalWallet, pays the relayer and returns the resulting token balances to Hinkal.

hinkalHelper.description: Helper used to compute relayer fees, read from the EmporiumStorage namespace.

entries.name: Hinkal
entries.description: Main Hinkal contract and escrow of all shielded funds. It accepts deposits, verifies Groth16 proofs of private transfers and withdrawals, keeps the commitment Merkle tree and spent nullifiers, and routes funds to registered external actions (swaps and other DeFi calls) on behalf of shielded users.

owner.description: Owner that registers and removes the zk proof verifiers. Ownership moves in two steps and cannot be renounced.

pendingOwner.description: Proposed new owner that still has to accept ownership.

hinkalHelper.description: Helper contract that validates relayers and token limits, and builds the public inputs checked against the proof. Replaceable by HINKAL_HELPER_MANAGER.

verifiers.description: Verifier contract for each verifierId, rebuilt from VerifierRegistered and VerifierRemoved events. The verifierId hashes the transaction dimensions (tokens, nullifiers, outputs) and the external action ID.

removedVerifierIds.description: verifierIds whose verifier was removed. A removed ID stays listed in verifiers with its last address but no longer verifies proofs, unless registered again later.

externalActionIds.description: Every externalActionId registered so far, taken from registerExternalAction calldata.

externalActions.description: External action contract currently registered for each ID in externalActionIds, in the same order (zero address: cleared). Shielded funds are sent to the registered contract, which runs the action and returns the output tokens.

externalActionRegistrations.description: Every address passed to registerExternalAction, including replaced and cleared registrations, from ExternalActionRegistered events.

accessControl.description: Role membership of the Hinkal contract.

helperManagers.description: Addresses with HINKAL_HELPER_MANAGER, which is its own admin role.
